history_columns.net_moment_z_Nm: Nominal reference-coordinate torque sum X cross F; not the current-position torque
history_columns.moment_impulse_z_Nms: Time integral of the nominal reference-coordinate torque
history_columns.absolute_impulse_Ns: Integral of sum of nodal force magnitudes; does not hide counter-shear cancellation

current_moment: Computed directly from actual x(t) cross native external force for every unique saved accepted FP64 state.
surface_caveat: Moved original triangle barycenters establish an algebraic moment/power identity only. Disconnected/deformed original triangles are not claimed to be actual newly exposed fluid boundaries.
current_angular_impulse: UNAVAILABLE_AT_EVERY_ACCEPTED_STEP; not reconstructed from insufficient sampled positions
